sloka: तदद्य विपुलं वीर दुःखमिन्द्रजिता कृतम्।कर्मणा व्यपनेष्यामि तस्मादुत्तिष्ठ राघव ।। ६.८३.४२ ।।
transliteration: tadadya vipulaṁ vīra duḥkhamindrajitā kṛtam।karmaṇā vyapaneṣyāmi tasmāduttiṣṭha rāghava ।। 6.83.42 ।।

translations.english: "Get up, heroic Raghava! I will get rid of the agony caused to you by Indrajith, by the action."
